title: National-ID OCR fixture manifest
description: Ground truth for one fixture set. Synthetic and real sets use this identical shape — that is what lets real anonymized cards be dropped into fixtures/real/ and measured with no code change.

id.description: Stable identifier, used in failure reports. Must NOT encode anything about a real person.

front.description: Front image filename, relative to this manifest.

back.description: Back image filename, relative to this manifest.

quality.description: Capture difficulty. Lets the report separate 'fails on bad photos' from 'fails generally' — the difference between a UX fix and a model change.

source.description: Drives the report's caveat. A run containing only 'synthetic' is reported as INCONCLUSIVE by design.

truth.description: Expected value per field. Omit a field the card does not carry; omitted fields are not scored. Transcribe EXACTLY what is printed, including orthography — the scorer applies the Arabic fold itself.

nationalId.description: ASCII digits, not Indic — the pipeline folds the card's numerals before comparison.

nationalIdExpiry.description: ISO-8601. The pipeline emits ISO on a successful parse, so truth uses it too.
